column2:
tan(n./adj./v.)曬黑的膚色、棕褐色的、曬黑
tanned(adj.)曬黑的
get a tan 曬黑
suntan lotion 防曬乳
She came back from Kenting with a deep tan.
(她從墾丁回來時曬得一身黝黑。)
He wore a tan jacket and dark blue jeans to the party.
(他穿著棕褐色夾克和深藍色牛仔褲去參加派對。)

tedious(adj.)冗長乏味的、單調的
tedium(n.)單調乏味
tediously(adv.)乏味地
tedious task 乏味的工作
tedious lecture 冗長無趣的演講
Copying the same words a hundred times is a tedious task.
(把同樣的字抄寫一百遍是件乏味的工作。)
The lecture was so tedious that several students fell asleep.
(那堂課冗長乏味到好幾個學生都睡著了。)

telecommunications(n.)電信、遠距通訊
telecommunication(n.)電信
telecommunications industry 電信業
telecommunications company 電信公司
The telecommunications industry has changed rapidly since smartphones appeared.
(自從智慧型手機問世後，電信業變化迅速。)
My uncle works as an engineer for a telecommunications company.
(我叔叔在一家電信公司擔任工程師。)

teller(n.)銀行出納員、講述者
tell(v.)講述、告訴
bank teller 銀行行員
fortune teller 算命師
The bank teller counted the money carefully before handing it to me.
(銀行行員在把錢交給我之前仔細清點了一遍。)
A fortune teller at the night market told me that I would be lucky this year.
(夜市裡的一位算命師告訴我，我今年會很幸運。)

tempo(n.)節奏、速度、拍子
(無詞性變化)
fast tempo 快節奏
tempo of life 生活步調
The song starts slowly, but the tempo increases toward the end.
(這首歌開頭很慢，但節奏在接近尾聲時加快。)
Many people move to the countryside to escape the fast tempo of city life.
(許多人搬到鄉下，以逃離城市生活的快速步調。)

tenant(n./v.)房客、承租人、租用
tenancy(n.)租賃、租期
landlord and tenant 房東與房客
tenant farmer 佃農
The landlord asked the tenants to pay the rent by the fifth of each month.
(房東要求房客每月五號前繳交房租。)
The new tenants moved into the apartment upstairs last week.
(新房客上週搬進了樓上的公寓。)

tentative(adj.)暫時的、試探性的、猶豫不決的
tentatively(adv.)暫時地、試探性地
tentative plan 暫定計畫
tentative step 試探性的一步
We have made a tentative plan to visit Japan next summer.
(我們暫定明年夏天去日本。)
The baby took a few tentative steps toward her mother.
(寶寶猶豫地朝媽媽走了幾步。)

terrace(n./v.)露臺、梯田、使成梯田
terraced(adj.)梯田式的、階梯狀的
rice terraces 梯田
outdoor terrace 戶外露臺
We had breakfast on the terrace overlooking the sea.
(我們在俯瞰大海的露臺上吃早餐。)
The rice terraces in the mountains look beautiful in spring.
(山上的梯田在春天看起來很美。)

textile(n./adj.)紡織品、紡織的
texture(n.)質地、紋理
textile industry 紡織業
textile factory 紡織廠
Taiwan's textile industry is famous for producing high-tech sportswear fabrics.
(臺灣的紡織業以生產高科技運動服布料聞名。)
The old textile factory has been turned into an art center.
(那座老紡織廠已改建為藝術中心。)

thereafter(adv.)此後、之後
(無詞性變化)
shortly thereafter 不久之後
and thereafter 此後
He moved to Tainan in 2010 and lived there for ten years thereafter.
(他於2010年搬到臺南，此後在那裡住了十年。)
The rain started at noon, and the game was canceled shortly thereafter.
(中午開始下雨，不久之後比賽就取消了。)

thermometer(n.)溫度計、體溫計
(無詞性變化)
digital thermometer 電子體溫計
thermometer reading 溫度計讀數
The nurse used a digital thermometer to take my temperature.
(護理師用電子體溫計幫我量體溫。)
The thermometer showed that it was thirty-eight degrees outside.
(溫度計顯示外面氣溫是三十八度。)

tilt(n./v.)傾斜、偏向、使傾斜
(無詞性變化)
tilt one's head 歪著頭
at full tilt 全速地
The puppy tilted its head when it heard a strange sound.
(小狗聽到奇怪的聲音時歪了歪頭。)
The picture on the wall is tilted slightly to the left.
(牆上的畫稍微向左傾斜。)

tiptoe(n./v.)腳尖、踮著腳走
(無詞性變化)
on tiptoe 踮著腳尖
tiptoe out of 躡手躡腳地走出
She stood on tiptoe to reach the book on the top shelf.
(她踮起腳尖去拿書架最上層的書。)
He tiptoed out of the room so as not to wake the baby.
(他躡手躡腳地走出房間，以免吵醒寶寶。)

tiresome(adj.)令人厭煩的、無聊的
tire(v.)使疲倦、厭倦
tiresome job 令人厭煩的工作
tiresome person 討人厭的人
Listening to his endless complaints is really tiresome.
(聽他沒完沒了地抱怨真的很煩人。)
Filling out all these forms is a tiresome but necessary job.
(填寫這些表格是件令人厭煩但必要的工作。)

token(n.)代幣、象徵、標誌、紀念品
(無詞性變化)
as a token of 作為……的象徵
by the same token 同樣地
Please accept this small gift as a token of our appreciation.
(請收下這份小禮物，聊表我們的謝意。)
In the past, you needed a token to ride the subway in some cities.
(過去在某些城市，搭地鐵需要使用代幣。)

tornado(n.)龍捲風
(無詞性變化)
tornado warning 龍捲風警報
be hit by a tornado 遭龍捲風侵襲
The town was badly damaged after being hit by a powerful tornado.
(這個小鎮遭強烈龍捲風侵襲後嚴重受損。)
When the tornado warning sounded, everyone hid in the basement.
(龍捲風警報響起時，大家都躲進了地下室。)

torrent(n.)急流、洪流、(言語等)連發
torrential(adj.)猛烈的、傾盆的
torrential rain 傾盆大雨
a torrent of 一連串的
Torrential rain caused serious flooding in southern Taiwan.
(傾盆大雨在南臺灣造成嚴重水災。)
The singer received a torrent of criticism after the concert was canceled.
(演唱會取消後，那位歌手遭到一連串批評。)

trademark(n.)商標、特徵、標誌
(無詞性變化)
registered trademark 註冊商標
trademark smile 招牌笑容
The company sued the factory for using its trademark without permission.
(那家公司控告該工廠未經許可使用其商標。)
Wearing a black turtleneck became Steve Jobs's trademark.
(穿黑色高領衫成了賈伯斯的招牌特色。)

transcript(n.)成績單、文字紀錄、謄本
transcribe(v.)謄寫、轉錄
official transcript 正式成績單
interview transcript 訪談逐字稿
You need to submit your high school transcript when applying to universities.
(申請大學時你需要繳交高中成績單。)
The reporter read the transcript of the president's speech carefully.
(記者仔細閱讀了總統演講的文字稿。)

transmit(v.)傳送、傳播、傳染
transmission(n.)傳送、傳播、變速器
transmitter(n.)發射器
transmit signals 傳送訊號
transmit diseases 傳播疾病
Mosquitoes can transmit diseases such as dengue fever.
(蚊子會傳播登革熱等疾病。)
The satellite transmits signals back to the Earth every few minutes.
(衛星每隔幾分鐘就將訊號傳回地球。)

transplant(n./v.)移植、移居
transplantation(n.)移植
organ transplant 器官移植
heart transplant 心臟移植
The patient needed a heart transplant to survive.
(這位病患需要心臟移植才能存活。)
The young trees were transplanted to a larger garden.
(那些小樹被移植到一座更大的花園。)

treasury(n.)國庫、財政部、寶庫
treasure(n./v.)寶藏、愛惜
national treasury 國庫
a treasury of 寶庫
The money for the new highway will come from the national treasury.
(新公路的經費將來自國庫。)
The museum is a treasury of ancient Chinese art.
(這座博物館是中國古代藝術的寶庫。)

trek(n./v.)長途跋涉、艱苦的旅行
trekking(n.)健行、徒步旅行
mountain trek 山區健行
trek across 徒步穿越
The hikers went on a three-day trek through the mountains.
(登山客進行了為期三天的山區健行。)
We had to trek across the desert to reach the ancient city.
(我們必須徒步穿越沙漠才能抵達那座古城。)

trifle(n./v.)瑣事、少量、輕視、玩弄
trifling(adj.)微不足道的
a trifle 有點、稍微
trifle with 玩弄、輕視
Don't get angry over such a trifle.
(別為了這種小事生氣。)
He is not a man to be trifled with.
(他可不是個能被輕視的人。)

trillion(n.)兆
(無詞性變化)
a trillion dollars 一兆元
trillions of 數兆的
The government's budget this year is more than two trillion dollars.
(政府今年的預算超過兩兆元。)
There are trillions of cells in the human body.
(人體內有數兆個細胞。)

tropic(n./adj.)回歸線、熱帶地區、熱帶的
tropical(adj.)熱帶的
Tropic of Cancer 北回歸線
the tropics 熱帶地區
The Tropic of Cancer passes through Chiayi in southern Taiwan.
(北回歸線通過臺灣南部的嘉義。)
Many colorful birds live in the tropics.
(許多色彩繽紛的鳥類生活在熱帶地區。)

trout(n.)鱒魚
(無詞性變化)
rainbow trout 虹鱒
trout fishing 釣鱒魚
My father caught a big rainbow trout in the mountain stream.
(我爸爸在山溪裡釣到一條大虹鱒。)
The restaurant serves grilled trout with lemon and herbs.
(這家餐廳供應搭配檸檬與香草的烤鱒魚。)

trustee(n.)受託人、理事
trust(n./v.)信任、信託
board of trustees 董事會、理事會
appoint a trustee 指定受託人
The board of trustees decided to build a new library for the university.
(董事會決定為大學興建一座新圖書館。)
His uncle was appointed as a trustee to manage the family's money.
(他叔叔被指定為受託人，負責管理家族的財產。)

tuck(v./n.)塞進、捲起、收攏、褶
(無詞性變化)
tuck in 把(衣服)塞好、給(小孩)蓋好被子
tuck away 藏起、收起
Please tuck in your shirt before the school ceremony.
(學校典禮前請把襯衫紮好。)
She tucked her children into bed and read them a story.
(她幫孩子們蓋好被子，並唸了一個故事給他們聽。)

turmoil(n.)騷動、混亂、動盪
(無詞性變化)
in turmoil 處於混亂中
political turmoil 政治動盪
The country was in turmoil after the sudden death of its leader.
(該國領導人猝逝後，全國陷入一片混亂。)
Her mind was in turmoil as she waited for the test results.
(她等待檢查結果時，心裡一團亂。)

twilight(n.)黃昏、暮色、衰退期
(無詞性變化)
at twilight 在黃昏時
twilight years 晚年
The city lights began to shine at twilight.
(黃昏時城市燈火開始亮起。)
The famous actor spent his twilight years in a small village.
(那位知名演員在一個小村莊度過晚年。)

twinkle(n./v.)閃爍、閃耀
(無詞性變化)
twinkle in one's eye 眼中閃爍的光芒
stars twinkle 星光閃爍
Stars twinkled in the clear night sky above the mountains.
(群山上方晴朗的夜空中星光閃爍。)
Grandpa told the joke with a twinkle in his eye.
(爺爺眼裡閃著光芒說了那個笑話。)

unanimous(adj.)全體一致的、無異議的
unanimously(adv.)全體一致地
unanimity(n.)全體一致
unanimous decision 一致的決定
unanimous vote 全票通過
The committee reached a unanimous decision to support the plan.
(委員會一致決定支持這項計畫。)
The proposal was passed by a unanimous vote.
(這項提案以全票通過。)

unconditional(adj.)無條件的、絕對的
unconditionally(adv.)無條件地
condition(n.)條件
unconditional love 無條件的愛
unconditional surrender 無條件投降
Parents usually give their children unconditional love.
(父母通常給予孩子無條件的愛。)
Japan's unconditional surrender in 1945 ended World War II.
(日本在1945年無條件投降，結束了第二次世界大戰。)

underestimate(v./n.)低估、輕視
estimate(v./n.)估計
overestimate(v.)高估
underestimate the cost 低估成本
never underestimate 永遠別小看
Never underestimate the power of hard work.
(永遠不要低估努力的力量。)
We underestimated how long it would take to finish the project.
(我們低估了完成這個專案所需的時間。)

underneath(prep./adv./n./adj.)在……下面、在底下、底部
(無詞性變化)
underneath the surface 在表面之下
from underneath 從底下
The cat is hiding underneath the sofa.
(那隻貓躲在沙發底下。)
He seems tough, but underneath he is a very kind person.
(他看起來很強悍，但內心其實是個非常善良的人。)

underpass(n.)地下道
overpass(n.)天橋、高架道路
pedestrian underpass 行人地下道
through the underpass 穿過地下道
Use the underpass to cross the busy road safely.
(利用地下道安全地穿越繁忙的馬路。)
The underpass was flooded after the heavy rain.
(大雨過後，地下道淹水了。)

underway(adv.)在進行中、已開始
(無詞性變化)
be well underway 進展順利、已在進行
get underway 開始
Preparations for the school anniversary are already well underway.
(校慶的籌備工作已經順利進行中。)
The meeting got underway at exactly nine o'clock.
(會議在九點整準時開始。)

unification(n.)統一、聯合
unify(v.)統一
unified(adj.)統一的
national unification 國家統一
German unification 德國統一
German unification took place in 1990 after the fall of the Berlin Wall.
(德國在柏林圍牆倒塌後於1990年統一。)
Qin Shi Huang is known for the unification of China in 221 BC.
(秦始皇以在西元前221年統一中國聞名。)

unify(v.)統一、使一致
unification(n.)統一
unified(adj.)統一的
unify the country 統一國家
unify efforts 整合力量
The coach tried to unify the team after their painful loss.
(在慘痛落敗後，教練試圖讓全隊團結一致。)
The company wants to unify all its services into one app.
(這家公司想把所有服務整合到同一個應用程式中。)

unveil(v.)揭幕、揭露、首次公開
veil(n./v.)面紗、遮掩
unveil a statue 為雕像揭幕
unveil a plan 公布計畫
The mayor unveiled a statue of the famous poet in the park.
(市長在公園為那位知名詩人的雕像揭幕。)
The company will unveil its latest smartphone next week.
(這家公司下週將發表最新款智慧型手機。)

upright(adv./adj./n.)直立地、筆直的、正直的、豎立物
(無詞性變化)
sit upright 坐直
upright citizen 正直的公民
Please keep your seat in the upright position during takeoff.
(起飛時請將椅背豎直。)
He was known as an honest and upright judge.
(他以誠實正直的法官而聞名。)

uprising(n.)起義、暴動
rise(v./n.)上升、起義
armed uprising 武裝起義
popular uprising 民眾起義
The uprising was quickly put down by the government.
(這場起義很快就被政府鎮壓了。)
The history teacher explained the causes of the peasant uprising.
(歷史老師解釋了那場農民起義的原因。)

upward(adj.)向上的、上升的
upwards(adv.)向上地
downward(adj.)向下的
upward trend 上升趨勢
upward movement 向上移動
There has been an upward trend in housing prices over the past ten years.
(過去十年來房價呈上升趨勢。)
The hot-air balloon began its slow upward journey into the morning sky.
(熱氣球開始緩緩向上升入晨空。)

upward(adv.)向上、往上
upwards(adv.)向上(同 upward)
look upward 抬頭往上看
upwards of 超過、多於
The children looked upward to watch the fireworks.
(孩子們抬頭往上看煙火。)
Upwards of a thousand people attended the concert in the park.
(超過一千人參加了公園裡的音樂會。)

urgency(n.)緊急、迫切
urgent(adj.)緊急的
urgently(adv.)緊急地
sense of urgency 緊迫感
a matter of urgency 緊急事件
There is a growing sense of urgency about climate change.
(人們對氣候變遷的緊迫感與日俱增。)
The problem should be dealt with as a matter of urgency.
(這個問題應作為緊急事項立即處理。)

usher(v./n.)引領、迎來、招待員、帶位員
(無詞性變化)
usher in 迎來、開創
usher someone to 引導某人到
The waiter ushered us to a table near the window.
(服務生帶我們到靠窗的座位。)
The invention of the smartphone ushered in a new era of communication.
(智慧型手機的發明開創了通訊的新時代。)

utensil(n.)器具、用具
(無詞性變化)
kitchen utensils 廚房用具
eating utensils 餐具
Bringing your own eating utensils helps reduce plastic waste.
(自備餐具有助於減少塑膠垃圾。)
The store sells all kinds of kitchen utensils, from knives to spatulas.
(這家店販售各式廚房用具，從刀子到鍋鏟都有。)

utter(adj./v.)完全的、徹底的、說出、發出(聲音)
utterly(adv.)完全地
utterance(n.)說出的話、發言
utter a word 說一句話
utter nonsense 一派胡言
She left the room without uttering a single word.
(她一句話也沒說就離開了房間。)
What he said about the test being canceled was utter nonsense.
(他說考試取消的事根本是一派胡言。)

vaccine(n.)疫苗
vaccinate(v.)接種疫苗
vaccination(n.)疫苗接種
flu vaccine 流感疫苗
develop a vaccine 研發疫苗
Scientists worked hard to develop a vaccine against the new virus.
(科學家們努力研發對抗新病毒的疫苗。)
Elderly people are encouraged to get the flu vaccine every year.
(長者被鼓勵每年接種流感疫苗。)

vanilla(n.)香草
(無詞性變化)
vanilla ice cream 香草冰淇淋
vanilla extract 香草精
Would you like chocolate or vanilla ice cream?
(你想要巧克力還是香草冰淇淋？)
Add a teaspoon of vanilla extract to the cake mixture.
(在蛋糕麵糊中加入一茶匙香草精。)

vanity(n.)虛榮心、自負、空虛
vain(adj.)虛榮的、徒勞的
out of vanity 出於虛榮
vanity fair 名利場
She bought the expensive bag out of vanity, not need.
(她買那個昂貴的包包是出於虛榮，而非需要。)
His vanity made him unable to admit his mistakes.
(他的自負使他無法承認自己的錯誤。)

vapor(n.)蒸氣、霧氣
vaporize(v.)使蒸發
evaporate(v.)蒸發
water vapor 水蒸氣
vapor trail 飛機凝結尾
Clouds are formed when water vapor cools in the air.
(水蒸氣在空氣中冷卻時便會形成雲。)
We could see the vapor trail left by the plane in the blue sky.
(我們能看到飛機在藍天中留下的凝結尾。)

veil(n./v.)面紗、遮蔽物、掩飾
unveil(v.)揭幕、揭露
veiled(adj.)蒙面紗的、隱約的
wedding veil 新娘頭紗
a veil of mist 一層薄霧
The bride wore a long white veil at the wedding.
(新娘在婚禮上戴著一條白色長頭紗。)
The mountain was hidden behind a veil of mist in the early morning.
(清晨時，那座山隱藏在一層薄霧之後。)

velvet(n./adj.)天鵝絨、絲絨、柔軟光滑的
velvety(adj.)天鵝絨般的、柔滑的
velvet dress 絲絨洋裝
red velvet cake 紅絲絨蛋糕
She wore an elegant black velvet dress to the concert.
(她穿著一件優雅的黑色絲絨洋裝去聽音樂會。)
The red velvet curtains in the old theater were replaced last year.
(老劇院裡的紅色天鵝絨布幕去年換新了。)

versatile(adj.)多才多藝的、多用途的
versatility(n.)多才多藝、多功能
versatile actor 戲路寬廣的演員
versatile tool 多功能工具
He is a versatile actor who can play both comedy and drama.
(他是位戲路寬廣的演員，喜劇和劇情片都能演。)
Eggs are a versatile ingredient that can be cooked in many ways.
(蛋是一種用途廣泛的食材，可用多種方式烹調。)

veterinarian(n.)獸醫
vet(n.)獸醫(口語)
veterinary(adj.)獸醫的
take a pet to the vet 帶寵物看獸醫
veterinary clinic 動物醫院
The veterinarian gave our dog a full check-up and some vaccines.
(獸醫幫我們的狗做了全身檢查並施打疫苗。)
My cat hasn't been eating well, so I'm taking her to the vet tomorrow.
(我的貓最近食慾不好，所以我明天要帶牠去看獸醫。)

veto(n./v.)否決、否決權
(無詞性變化)
veto power 否決權
veto a bill 否決法案
The president used his veto to block the new tax law.
(總統動用否決權阻擋了新稅法。)
My parents vetoed my plan to travel alone during summer vacation.
(我爸媽否決了我暑假獨自旅行的計畫。)

vibrate(v.)震動、振動
vibration(n.)震動
vibrant(adj.)充滿活力的、鮮豔的
phone vibrates 手機震動
vibrate with 因……而震動
Please set your phone to vibrate during the performance.
(表演期間請將手機設為震動模式。)
The windows vibrated as the heavy trucks passed by.
(重型卡車駛過時，窗戶隨之震動。)

vibration(n.)震動、振動、感受
vibrate(v.)震動
feel the vibration 感受到震動
sound vibration 聲波振動
We could feel the vibration of the earthquake even on the tenth floor.
(即使在十樓，我們也能感受到地震的震動。)
Sound is created by the vibration of air.
(聲音是由空氣振動產生的。)

vice(n.)惡行、缺點、罪惡
vicious(adj.)惡毒的、兇猛的
virtue and vice 美德與惡行
vice president 副總統、副總裁
Laziness is his greatest vice.
(懶惰是他最大的缺點。)
The story teaches children the difference between virtue and vice.
(這個故事教導孩子分辨美德與惡行。)

victor(n.)勝利者、征服者
victory(n.)勝利
victorious(adj.)勝利的
emerge as the victor 成為勝利者
to the victor go the spoils 勝者為王
After a long and difficult match, she emerged as the victor.
(經過一場漫長艱難的比賽，她成為了勝利者。)
History is often written by the victors.
(歷史往往是由勝利者書寫的。)

vigor(n.)活力、精力、氣勢
vigorous(adj.)精力充沛的、強而有力的
vigorously(adv.)有力地
with vigor 精力充沛地
renewed vigor 重新振作
The team started the second half with renewed vigor.
(全隊以重新振作的士氣展開下半場比賽。)
Even at eighty, my grandfather still works in the garden with great vigor.
(即使已經八十歲，我爺爺仍精力充沛地在花園裡工作。)

vigorous(adj.)精力充沛的、強而有力的、激烈的
vigor(n.)活力
vigorously(adv.)有力地
vigorous exercise 劇烈運動
vigorous debate 激烈的辯論
Doctors recommend at least twenty minutes of vigorous exercise three times a week.
(醫生建議每週至少做三次、每次二十分鐘的劇烈運動。)
The new policy led to a vigorous debate in the legislature.
(新政策在立法院引發激烈的辯論。)

villa(n.)別墅
(無詞性變化)
holiday villa 度假別墅
luxury villa 豪華別墅
The family rented a villa by the sea for the summer vacation.
(那家人在暑假時租了一間海邊的別墅。)
The wealthy businessman owns a luxury villa in the mountains.
(那位富商在山上擁有一棟豪華別墅。)

villain(n.)壞人、惡棍、反派角色
villainous(adj.)邪惡的
play the villain 飾演反派
the villain of the piece 罪魁禍首
The actor is famous for playing villains in action movies.
(那位演員以在動作片中飾演反派而聞名。)
In the end, the hero defeated the villain and saved the city.
(最後，英雄打敗了壞人，拯救了城市。)

vine(n.)藤蔓、葡萄藤
vineyard(n.)葡萄園
grape vine 葡萄藤
climbing vine 攀爬藤蔓
Green vines covered the walls of the old house.
(綠色藤蔓爬滿了那棟老房子的牆。)
The farmer checks the grape vines every morning.
(農夫每天早上都檢查葡萄藤。)

vineyard(n.)葡萄園
vine(n.)藤蔓、葡萄藤
visit a vineyard 參觀葡萄園
family-owned vineyard 家族經營的葡萄園
We visited a vineyard in Changhua and picked fresh grapes.
(我們參觀了彰化的一座葡萄園，還採了新鮮葡萄。)
The family has owned this vineyard for over a hundred years.
(這個家族擁有這座葡萄園已超過一百年。)

violinist(n.)小提琴家、小提琴手
violin(n.)小提琴
talented violinist 有天分的小提琴家
solo violinist 小提琴獨奏家
The young violinist won first prize in the international competition.
(那位年輕小提琴家在國際比賽中奪得首獎。)
She practices for hours every day because she wants to be a professional violinist.
(她每天練習好幾個小時，因為她想成為職業小提琴家。)

virgin(n./adj.)處女、原始的、未開發的、未使用過的
virginity(n.)童貞
virgin forest 原始森林
extra virgin olive oil 特級初榨橄欖油
The mountain is covered by virgin forest that has never been cut down.
(這座山覆蓋著從未被砍伐過的原始森林。)
Extra virgin olive oil is often used in salads.
(特級初榨橄欖油常用於沙拉中。)

vitality(n.)活力、生命力
vital(adj.)極重要的、生命的
full of vitality 充滿活力
economic vitality 經濟活力
The children's laughter filled the old house with vitality.
(孩子們的笑聲讓老房子充滿了活力。)
Small businesses are important to the economic vitality of a city.
(小型企業對城市的經濟活力很重要。)

vocation(n.)職業、天職、使命感
vocational(adj.)職業的
sense of vocation 使命感
find one's vocation 找到天職
She felt that teaching was her true vocation.
(她覺得教書是她真正的天職。)
Doctors need a strong sense of vocation to work such long hours.
(醫生需要強烈的使命感才能長時間工作。)

vocational(adj.)職業的、職業訓練的
vocation(n.)職業、天職
vocational school 職業學校、技職學校
vocational training 職業訓練
He chose to attend a vocational school to learn auto repair.
(他選擇就讀技職學校學習汽車修護。)
The government offers free vocational training for people who lose their jobs.
(政府為失業者提供免費的職業訓練。)

vowel(n.)母音
consonant(n.)子音
vowel sound 母音
short vowel 短母音
The English alphabet has five vowels: a, e, i, o, and u.
(英文字母中有五個母音：a、e、i、o、u。)
Pay attention to the short vowel sounds when you read these words.
(念這些單字時請注意短母音的發音。)

wag(v./n.)搖擺、搖動(尾巴)
(無詞性變化)
wag its tail 搖尾巴
wag a finger 搖手指(表示責備)
The dog wagged its tail happily when its owner came home.
(主人回家時，狗開心地搖著尾巴。)
The teacher wagged her finger at the students who were talking in class.
(老師對著上課講話的學生搖手指表示責備。)

walnut(n.)核桃、胡桃木
(無詞性變化)
walnut tree 核桃樹
walnut furniture 胡桃木家具
Walnuts are rich in healthy fats that are good for the brain.
(核桃富含有益大腦的健康脂肪。)
The antique table is made of solid walnut.
(這張古董桌是用實心胡桃木做的。)

ward(n./v.)病房、行政區、受監護人、避開
warden(n.)看守人、典獄長
hospital ward 醫院病房
ward off 擋開、防止
The nurse checks on the patients in the ward every two hours.
(護理師每兩個小時巡視一次病房裡的病人。)
Some people believe that garlic can ward off evil spirits.
(有些人相信大蒜可以驅邪。)

wardrobe(n.)衣櫥、全部服裝、戲服
(無詞性變化)
built-in wardrobe 嵌入式衣櫥
summer wardrobe 夏季服裝
She hung all her dresses neatly in the wardrobe.
(她把所有洋裝整齊地掛在衣櫥裡。)
It's time to update my wardrobe for the new season.
(該為新季節添購新衣服了。)

warrant(n.)令狀、搜索票、正當理由
warranty(n.)保固、保證書
search warrant 搜索票
arrest warrant 逮捕令
The police obtained a search warrant before entering the house.
(警方在進入那棟房子之前先取得了搜索票。)
There is no warrant for such rude behavior.
(這種無禮的行為毫無正當理由。)

warranty(n.)保固、保證書
warrant(n.)令狀、正當理由
under warranty 在保固期內
one-year warranty 一年保固
My laptop is still under warranty, so the repair is free.
(我的筆電還在保固期內，所以維修是免費的。)
The washing machine comes with a two-year warranty.
(這台洗衣機附有兩年保固。)

waterproof(adj./v.)防水的、使防水
water(n./v.)水、澆水
waterproof jacket 防水外套
waterproof watch 防水手錶
Bring a waterproof jacket in case it rains on the mountain.
(帶件防水外套，以防山上下雨。)
This watch is waterproof up to fifty meters.
(這支手錶可防水達五十公尺。)

weary(adj./v.)疲倦的、厭倦的、使疲倦
weariness(n.)疲倦、厭倦
wearily(adv.)疲倦地
weary of 厭倦
weary traveler 疲憊的旅人
The weary travelers finally arrived at the hotel late at night.
(疲憊的旅客們終於在深夜抵達飯店。)
People are growing weary of the endless political arguments.
(人們越來越厭倦無止盡的政治爭論。)

wharf(n./v.)碼頭、停靠碼頭
(無詞性變化)
Fisherman's Wharf 漁人碼頭
along the wharf 沿著碼頭
We watched the sunset at Tamsui Fisherman's Wharf.
(我們在淡水漁人碼頭看夕陽。)
The ship was unloaded at the wharf early in the morning.
(那艘船一大早就在碼頭卸貨。)

whiskey(n.)威士忌
whisky(n.)威士忌(英式拼法)
Scotch whisky 蘇格蘭威士忌
a glass of whiskey 一杯威士忌
Taiwanese whisky has won several international awards in recent years.
(臺灣威士忌近年來贏得了好幾項國際大獎。)
He ordered a glass of whiskey with ice at the bar.
(他在酒吧點了一杯加冰塊的威士忌。)

wholesale(adj./adv./n./v.)批發的、大規模的、以批發方式、批發
wholesaler(n.)批發商
retail(n./v.)零售
wholesale price 批發價
wholesale market 批發市場
Restaurants usually buy vegetables at wholesale prices.
(餐廳通常以批發價購買蔬菜。)
The fruit is sold wholesale to supermarkets across the country.
(這些水果以批發方式銷售給全國的超市。)

wholesome(adj.)有益健康的、有益身心的
wholesomeness(n.)有益健康
wholesome food 健康的食物
wholesome entertainment 有益身心的娛樂
My grandmother always cooks simple but wholesome meals for us.
(我奶奶總是為我們準備簡單卻健康的餐點。)
The TV channel aims to provide wholesome entertainment for families.
(這個電視頻道致力於提供有益身心的闔家娛樂。)

widow(n.)寡婦
widower(n.)鰥夫
widowed(adj.)喪偶的
become a widow 守寡
elderly widower 年長的鰥夫
She became a widow at the age of fifty and raised her three children alone.
(她五十歲時守寡，獨自撫養三個孩子。)
The elderly widower lives with his daughter's family.
(那位年長的鰥夫和女兒一家同住。)

withhold(v.)保留、扣留、拒絕給予
withholding(n.)扣繳、扣留
withhold information 隱瞞資訊
withhold payment 暫緩付款
The police decided to withhold the victim's name from the public.
(警方決定不對外公布被害者的姓名。)
The company withheld payment until the work was finished properly.
(公司在工作確實完成前暫緩付款。)

woe(n.)悲哀、苦惱、災難
woeful(adj.)悲哀的、糟糕的
tale of woe 悲慘的遭遇
financial woes 財務困境
He told me a long tale of woe about losing his wallet and phone.
(他向我訴說了一段弄丟錢包和手機的悲慘遭遇。)
The airline's financial woes forced it to cancel many flights.
(那家航空公司的財務困境迫使它取消了許多航班。)

woodpecker(n.)啄木鳥
(無詞性變化)
woodpecker pecks 啄木鳥啄木
green woodpecker 綠啄木鳥
We heard a woodpecker tapping on a tree in the forest.
(我們在森林裡聽到一隻啄木鳥在啄樹。)
Woodpeckers use their strong beaks to find insects inside trees.
(啄木鳥用強壯的喙找出樹裡面的昆蟲。)

workforce(n.)勞動力、全體員工
(無詞性變化)
skilled workforce 技術勞動力
enter the workforce 進入職場
Many young people enter the workforce right after graduating from college.
(許多年輕人大學一畢業就進入職場。)
The company plans to reduce its workforce by ten percent.
(這家公司計畫裁減百分之十的員工。)

wrestle(v./n.)摔角、扭打、努力解決
wrestler(n.)摔角選手
wrestling(n.)摔角運動
wrestle with 努力解決、與……搏鬥
wrestle someone to the ground 把某人摔倒在地
The police officer wrestled the thief to the ground.
(警察把小偷摔倒在地上。)
She has been wrestling with the difficult math problem for an hour.
(她已經為這道難解的數學題苦思了一個小時。)

wrinkle(n./v.)皺紋、皺褶、使起皺
wrinkled(adj.)有皺紋的、起皺的
wrinkle-free 免燙的、無皺的
fine wrinkles 細紋
My grandmother has many wrinkles, but her smile is still beautiful.
(我奶奶有很多皺紋，但她的笑容依然美麗。)
Hang your shirt up so it won't wrinkle.
(把襯衫掛起來，才不會起皺。)

yearn(v.)渴望、思念
yearning(n.)渴望、思慕
yearn for 渴望
yearn to 渴望做
Many people working overseas yearn for home during the holidays.
(許多在海外工作的人在節日期間特別思念家鄉。)
She has always yearned to travel around the world.
(她一直渴望環遊世界。)

yoga(n.)瑜伽
(無詞性變化)
practice yoga 練瑜伽
yoga class 瑜伽課
My mother practices yoga every morning to stay healthy and relaxed.
(我媽媽每天早上練瑜伽，以保持健康和放鬆。)
She signed up for a yoga class at the community center.
(她報名了社區活動中心的瑜伽課。)

yogurt(n.)優格、優酪乳
(無詞性變化)
plain yogurt 原味優格
frozen yogurt 霜凍優格
I usually eat plain yogurt with fresh fruit for breakfast.
(我早餐通常吃原味優格配新鮮水果。)
Yogurt contains good bacteria that are helpful for digestion.
(優格含有對消化有幫助的好菌。)

zoom(v./n.)急速移動、(鏡頭)拉近或拉遠、急升
(無詞性變化)
zoom in 拉近鏡頭、放大
zoom past 呼嘯而過
You can zoom in on the map to see the street names more clearly.
(你可以把地圖放大，看清楚街道名稱。)
A sports car zoomed past us on the highway.
(一輛跑車在高速公路上從我們旁邊呼嘯而過。)
